callouts.title: 对identity theorem的抽象
callouts.body: 为了验证，在$U$上拥有某种好的正则性$P$的两个函数$f,g$恒等，我们只需要验证在子集$S\subset U$上恒等。即正则性强的对象，局部信息包含了全局信息。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Identity theorem reduction from a subset
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To prove that two sufficiently regular functions on a domain are identical, it can be enough to verify equality on a smaller subset. Strong regularity lets local or partial information determine the global function.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when working with classes of functions whose values on a dense set, accumulation set, or other determining subset uniquely determine the whole function.

callouts.title: 定理1.1：连续函数的identity theorem
callouts.body: 假设映射$f,g:X\to Y$是从拓扑空间$X$到$Y$的两个连续映射，其中$Y$是Hausdroff的。如果两个函数$$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in Z$$其中$Z\subset X$是一个稠密子集。那么$$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in X$$

classification_result.english_title: Theorem 1.1: Identity Theorem for Continuous Functions

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f,g:X\to Y$ be continuous maps from a topological space $X$ to a Hausdorff space $Y$. If $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in Z$$ for some dense subset $Z\subset X$, then $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in X.$$
key_techniques: closedness of the diagonal in a Hausdorff space

callouts.title: 定理1.2：连续函数的identity theorem的变体
callouts.body:
假设映射$f,g:X\to Y$是从拓扑空间$X$到$Y$的两个连续映射，其中$Y$是Hausdroff的有序拓扑空间,并且其上的序关系"$\leq$"与拓扑是相容的，即集合$\{(y_1,y_2)\in Y\times Y:y_1\leq y_2\}$是一个闭集。

那么如果两个函数$$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in Z$$其中$Z\subset X$是一个稠密子集。那么$$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in X$$

classification_result.english_title: Theorem 1.2: A Variant of the Identity Theorem for Continuous Functions

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f,g:X\to Y$ be continuous maps from a topological space $X$ to a Hausdorff ordered topological space $Y$, and assume the order relation is compatible with the topology in the sense that $\{(y_1,y_2)\in Y\times Y:y_1\leq y_2\}$ is closed. If $$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in Z$$ for some dense subset $Z\subset X$, then $$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in X.$$

callouts.title: 定理2.1.1
callouts.body: 如果定义在复平面上的全纯函数$f$在连通开集子集$U$的某个含有聚点(极限点)的某个子集$S\subset U$上等于0,并且聚点在$U$当中，那么函数在整个$U$上等于0.

if_problem.statement_en: If a holomorphic function $f$ on an open connected subset $U$ of the complex plane is equal to $0$ on some subset $S\subset U$ having an accumulation point in $U$, then $f$ is identically zero on all of $U$.

callouts.title: 反例2.1.2
callouts.body:
$$g(z):= \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{z}\right)$$
函数$g$在0的位置是一个本性奇点,然后函数在$z = \frac{1}{n},n\in\mathbb{Z}\setminus \{0\}$上都是零点，其聚点是$0$.函数$g$在开连通区域$D_r(0)\setminus\{0\}$上全纯,0虽然是聚点但是$0 \not \in D_r(0)\setminus\{0\}$.在这种情况下，聚点不在开连通区域里面的时候，我们不能得到函数是0函数的结论。

if_problem.statement_en: Consider $$g(z):= \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{z}\right).$$ The function $g$ has an essential singularity at $0$, and $g\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)=0$ for all $n\in\mathbb{Z}\setminus\{0\}$. The zeros accumulate at $0$, but on the punctured disk $D_r(0)\setminus\{0\}$ the point $0$ is not in the domain. Hence one cannot conclude that $g$ is identically zero when the accumulation point of zeros lies outside the domain.

callouts.title: 命题2.1.3:一元复解析函数在开连通区域上零点是孤立的
callouts.body: $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$是定义在非空开连通子集$U$上的**非零**全纯函数，并且$z_0\in U$是其一个零点，那么存在一个圆盘$D(z_0,r)$使得函数在圆盘里面，除了$z_0$以外没有任何其他零点。

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 2.1.3: Zeros of a One-Variable Complex Analytic Function Are Isolated on an Open Connected Set

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$ be a nonzero holomorphic function on a nonempty open connected set $U$, and let $z_0\in U$ be a zero of $f$. Then there exists a disk $D(z_0,r)$ such that $z_0$ is the only zero of $f$ in that disk.
key_techniques: factorization by the order of vanishing

callouts.title: 反例2.1.4
callouts.body:
假设不是连通的一个开集,比如$U=A\cup B$,其中$A,B$是两个不相交的开集。
$$f(z):=\begin{cases}0&z \in A\\ 1&z \in B\end{cases}$$
此时函数在$U$上全纯，并且不恒等于0，但是零点也非孤立。

if_problem.statement_en: If the domain is not connected, for example $U=A\cup B$ with $A,B$ disjoint open sets, define $$f(z):=\begin{cases}0&z \in A\\ 1&z \in B\end{cases}.$$ Then $f$ is holomorphic on $U$ and is not identically zero, but its zeros are not isolated.
key_techniques: failure of isolated zeros without connectedness
prerequisites: open sets in the complex plane

callouts.title: 命题2.1.5:一元实解析函数在开区间上零点是孤立的
callouts.body: 令$f:I\to \mathbb{R}$是一个定义在开区间$I$上的一元非零实解析函数，则$f$在$I$上的所有零点都是孤立的。

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 2.1.5: Zeros of a One-Variable Real Analytic Function Are Isolated on an Open Interval

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f:I\to \mathbb{R}$ be a nonzero real analytic function on an open interval $I$. Then all zeros of $f$ in $I$ are isolated.

callouts.title: 反例2.1.6:一元非零实光滑函数在开区间上的零点稠密
callouts.body: 考虑函数$$f(x):=\begin{cases}e^{-1/x}&x>0\\0&x\leq0\end{cases}$$这是一个光滑函数，因为函数$f$在$x=0$处任意阶可导，且导数为$0$但是显然函数在$\mathbb{R}$这个开区间上，零点并不是孤立的。从这里也可以反推，此函数一定不是$\mathbb{R}$上的实解析函数。

classification_result.english_title: Counterexample 2.1.6: A Nonzero Smooth Real Function Whose Zeros Are Dense on an Open Interval

if_problem.statement_en: Consider $$f(x):=\begin{cases}e^{-1/x}&x>0\\0&x\leq0\end{cases}.$$ This is a smooth function because all derivatives at $x=0$ exist and are equal to $0$. However, on $\mathbb{R}$ its zeros are not isolated, so this shows that a nonzero smooth function need not have isolated zeros and therefore need not be real analytic.
key_techniques: flat smooth function at a point

callouts.title: 定理2.2
callouts.body: 全纯函数$f$在连通开集$U\subset \mathbb{C}^n$上的某个连通开子集$S\subset U$上恒等于0，那么函数在整个$U$上等于0.

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f$ be holomorphic on a connected open set $U\subset \mathbb{C}^n$. If $f$ vanishes identically on some connected open subset $S\subset U$, then $f$ vanishes identically on all of $U$.
